# Real-photo regression fixture

`salad-real.jpg`: real photograph fetched from Unsplash image CDN, 640 px version:
https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1546069901-ba9599a7e63c?w=640&q=85&fm=jpg

Used only for browser segmentation tests; it is not inserted into users' records or shipped in the public app directory. Food labels used in geometry tests are test labels, not nutritional recognition output.
